从V2.0.0开始，脉冲输出指令统一使用双字整数作为参数。之前版本使用单字整数脉: Starting from V2.0.0, pulse output commands uniformly use double-word integers as parameters. Projects that used single-word integer pulse commands in previous versions will be forcibly converted to the corresponding double-word integer pulse commands. Please be sure to pay attention to adjustments for these changes.
从V2.2.46开始，工程内部文件夹新增了密码属性，来保护里面的内容。所以为了安: Starting from V2.2.46, an encryption attribute has been added to internal project folders to protect their contents. Therefore, for security reasons, older software versions V2.2.45 and earlier cannot open files from V2.2.46 and later. Please notify users to update to the latest version as soon as possible.
Starting from V2.2.49, enhanced encryption protection and password protection have been added within the project. Therefore, for security reasons, older software versions V2.2.48 and earlier cannot open files from V2.2.49 and later. Please notify to update to the latest version as soon as possible.

Project files that originally used the function codes related to double words will be automatically converted to the corresponding single-word function codes.
从V2.3.22开始，工程资源管理器内不再自动排序，可以拖动调整顺序。: Starting from V2.3.22, the project resource explorer no longer automatically sorts; the order can be adjusted by dragging.
从V2.3.23开始，DVIT指令做了大改动，可以设置任意中断信号(X/Y/M): Starting from V2.3.23, the DVIT command has undergone major changes, allowing you to set any interrupt signal (X/Y/M) and enable signal (X/Y/M).
从V2.3.2开始，ZRN和ZRNR添加了加速时间和减速时间这两个参数。原来有用: Starting from V2.3.2, ZRN and ZRNR have added two parameters: acceleration time and deceleration time. For projects that previously used these two instructions, these parameters are in the default state when enabled. Please complete filling them in as soon as possible.
